kind: Independent consuming search registration, retained compiled modules and compiler/search/reading artifact DAG
removed: The combined observe-atlas.py compiler/search driver is deleted. Compiler extraction no longer executes candidate search.

implementation.port: Search Registry freezes CounterexampleSearch role, both typed schemas and complete method configuration. Invocation owns the original compiler observation and source snapshot; postflight requires the original method/request, complete valid declaration coverage and active host control before returning an opaque completion.
implementation.raw_compilation: Raw compiled descriptions carry no check. The compiler port refuses search results; a public source explanation requires a complete check. Frozen modules are retained by complete source/binding/resource/file-byte identity with bounded regular-file-only traversal. Missing/changed retained bytes force real recompilation through ordinary preparation; invalid cached modules are replaced from that fresh result. Traversal is iterative and bounded to 8192 total entries, 256 files and 512 MiB; root/internal links are refused.

artifacts.compiler: Original descriptor and immutable unsearched snapshot, including retained frozen module identity or original prepared-Lake fingerprint.
artifacts.search: Original compiler observation ID, original search descriptor and complete typed per-declaration checks.
artifacts.reading: Original compiler observation ID, original renderer descriptor and only sentence/renderer/error overlays. Search results are not renderer inputs.
artifacts.publication: The graph revision binds the selected search and reading artifacts. A reading overlay cannot replace the newly selected check. Cache hit diagnostics require compilation, search and reading reuse.

implementation.execution: Frozen search and prepared-Lake search use separate fixed read-only offline profiles. Declared sources/metadata and original resources are rechecked. Prepared Lake inputs are fingerprinted again after search. The actual Plausible algorithm retains fixed sampling/heartbeat parameters; seed and wall limits are captured once from trusted host settings.

screens_inspected: Actual Lake source-inventory failure and historical restart
Meaning cancellation/provider failure with preserved historical assessment
HTTP 429 stop, restart review and explicit retry

actual_lean_failure_isolation.scope: Actual Lean/Plausible compiler-budget failure preserves English and permits a later normal observation; direct installed-tool test, not a confinement or proof claim.

scenarios: Seed 0 to 19 reuses compilation and English; only actual search executes, then a complete same-seed cache survives restart
Corrupted retained module bytes recover through ordinary file opening, real recompilation and seed-20 search
Actual GF resource update preserves the search artifact and executes no compiler/search worker; actual invalid source fails and Retry recovers
Real prepared 35-module Lake build, exact dependency/source/configuration changes, failure/retry and restart
Actual compiled English/Plausible candidates, assumptions, predicates, non-propositions and unsupported/budget outcomes in a large inventory
Prepared file/map tabs retain source, graph and camera without more inspections

faults: Unknown/duplicate search registration and wrong role/input schema refused
Original input and method cannot be substituted after dispatch
Cancellation before or after a call refuses completion
Missing/foreign checks and raw unsearched publication refused
Search and rendering cache partitioning, changed report bytes and colliding indices refused
Reading reuse preserves the newly selected search seed and witness
Changed compiled bytes, root/internal symlinks and excessive empty-directory inventories are refused
checks.initial_failure: The structural renderer fallback initially advertised its old input schema. The actual no-GF public Lake TUI journey rejected it; its descriptor now derives the implementation associated type, and the unchanged public journey passes.

actual_toolchain_preparation.scope: Public setup-atlas against both installed project toolchains. Actual library preparation only, not a complete fresh project analysis or cold installation.

deployment.scope: Idle unapproved existing hosts only; actual rendered map areas checked after startup, no inference grant restored. Frontend assets are unchanged.

limits: No authority-kernel transition or new extracted refinement; registry/cache/resource checks remain tested host adapters.
Search outcomes are candidates or explicitly inconclusive data, never accepted-contract evidence or a proof of no counterexample.
Frozen input and resource checks do not prove arbitrary host/filesystem mutation semantics. Native registrations are trusted host code.
These journeys execute installed Lean/Lake/Plausible/GF; model replies in the required gate are scripted. This turn makes no new live-model, cold-install, local-large-model or complete R1 claim.
remaining: Persistent selection among verifiers sharing a format
Generic inventory/job/evidence DTOs, remaining generated native wire definitions and explicit unsupported/binary source states
Persisted versioned deterministic layout and remaining legacy/demo retirement
Further measured reduction of exact-input preparation and first-selection latency
